subject: Priority Pathway — SLA packaging & onboarding incentive
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen@acme-systems.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SLA & support needs for pilot — high level

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team found the runtime performance impressive. We're getting close to internal approval for a two-month enterprise pilot, but procurement has asked for a clear support offering covering uptime guarantees, response windows, and escalation coverage. High-level asks from our side: 

- Uptime tiers (we're evaluating 99.5% vs 99.9% vs an SLA for multi-region failover)
- Response targets for Severity 1/2/3 incidents (including business hours vs 24x7)
- Escalation coverage (who we contact beyond the primary CSM/AE; RACI for oncall)
- Pricing for each tier and whether credits/financial remedies are part of the SLA

Also be good to understand if there's a short-term onboarding credit when we commit to a 12-month Dedicated reservation (we're likely to expand after pilot). I've attached our internal support requirements (Acme-Support-Reqs.pdf).

Can you send a concise packaging proposal we can share with procurement? Ideally a simple table with the three tiers and price bands. If it helps, we can do a quick call later this week.

Best,
Ellen

--
Ellen Park
Head of Platform Engineering, Acme Systems
ellen@acme-systems.com

Attachment: Acme-Support-Reqs.pdf (1 page)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@acme-systems.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-22T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SLA & support needs for pilot — high level

Hi Ellen — thanks for the clear ask and the attachment. I've summarized a compact packaging proposal below for procurement to review. Attaching a one-page pricing workbook for quick numbers.

Proposed packaging (summary):

1) Standard — "Assured"
- Uptime target: 99.5% monthly
- Response: P1 (1 hour, business hours M-F), P2 (4 hours), P3 (24 hours)
- Escalation: Primary CSM + Tier 2 oncall; 8x5 coverage; P1 escalates to engineering lead via pager after 2 hours
- Price: $0.08/token equivalent (pilot pricing band) / or $6k/mo flat retainer for baseline support

2) Enhanced — "Available"
- Uptime target: 99.9% monthly
- Response: P1 (30 minutes, 24x7), P2 (2 hours), P3 (8 hours)
- Escalation: CSM + dedicated oncall rotation + access to priority engineer triage; formal SRE escalation path; named SLA contacts
- Price: $0.12/token equivalent / or $14k/mo retainer (volume dependent)

3) Critical — "Priority Pathway"
- Uptime target: 99.95% (or multi-region failover tested monthly)
- Response: P1 (15 minutes, 24x7 with follow-the-sun), P2 (1 hour), P3 (4 hours)
- Escalation: Direct access to on-call engineering lead, guaranteed remediation timeline, monthly post-incident review, optional on-site for DR rehearsals
- Price: Custom quoting; typically starts at $38k/mo for Dedicated pools + SLA guarantee

SLA credits: Financial credit schedule available (slabbed by downtime %), we typically provide service credits (1–10% of monthly fee depending on severity/length) for the Enhanced and Critical tiers.

Onboarding incentive: We can offer a one-time credit of up to $10k off the first full month if you commit to a 12-month Dedicated reservation at negotiation. Rishi is copied to confirm internal feasibility.

Next steps I propose: 
- Quick alignment call (30m) to confirm which tier aligns with Acme's risk appetite and whether the onboarding credit is needed for procurement sign-off.
- If agreed, we'll draft an SOW with explicit uptime measurements, credit table, and a mutual action plan for pilot go-live.

When are you available this week for a call?

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-23T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Priority Pathway — SLA packaging & onboarding incentive

Looping in a quick ops perspective — forwarding Neha's summary and adding two notes inline.

> From Neha: [proposal summary]

Rishi notes:
- For a pilot that expects to convert to Dedicated, we should offer a time-limited 30% onboarding credit (capped at $12k) instead of a flat $10k — it gives us leverage and scales with the customer's size.
- Multi-region failover SLA: we recommend defining an "RTO window" for failover exercises (e.g., failover completed within 45 minutes under test conditions) and keep the financial credit tied to measured production failover failures only. That avoids disputes over planned failovers.

Operational ask: if Acme wants 24x7 P1 for Enhanced, we should request a minimum commit (monthly tokens or $ commit) to make the rota predictable. I'll draft a short appendix we can add to the SOW to codify failover tests and measurement methodology. Jonas, can you review the proposed remediation timelines and the credit slab?

-r

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Ellen Park <ellen@acme-systems.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-26T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Priority Pathway — SLA packaging & onboarding incentive

Neha, Rishi — thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear options. Procurement is leaning toward the Enhanced tier with the 24x7 P1, but they want the following clarified in the SOW before sign-off:

1) Confirmation of the onboarding credit mechanics (prefer a simple $ credit capped at a fixed amount vs a % to avoid accounting back-and-forth).
2) Clear definition of the multi-region failover SLA and the test cadence.
3) A minimum monthly commitment that triggers 24x7 coverage and the onboarding credit.

If you can send a one-page SOW addendum that answers those three points, procurement can potentially sign the pilot order next week. We also attached our deployment outline which includes the proposed cutover windows and regional traffic split.

Short list of attachments: Acme-deployment-plan.docx

Appreciate the accommodation, looking forward to the short SOW addendum.

Best,
Ellen
